Question 3
?

A particle P moves along the x-axis. When the displacement of P from the origin O is x meters, its velocity is vm/s and its acceleration is (3ex+1)m/s2. Which differential equation describes this motion?

a
ddx(12v2)=3ex+1
b
ddx(2v2)=3ex+1
c
ddx(v2)=3ex+1
d
dvdx=3ex+1
e
12dvdx=3ex+1
Submit
